title: EventAssessment
description: Structured output contract every EventIntelligence adapter (Gemini today, any future LLM provider) must return. Mirrors the Go type application/ports/output.EventAssessment and the responseSchema built in internal/infrastructure/external/llm/gemini/types.go. The model NEVER returns anything beyond this classification — no tool calls, no order instructions.

event_type.description: Free-text classification label, e.g. REGULATORY, HACK, MACRO, EXCHANGE_OUTAGE.

action.description: Deterministic instruction consumed by domain/risk specifications. Never itself an order.
